ios.desc:
The fastest Apple Watch keyboard, now better than ever.

With powerful Auto-Correct, Swipe Typing, customization features, and more, FlickType will change the way you use your Apple Watch.

SURPRISINGLY SMART.
Don't slow down or try to be accurate. Just tap where it feels right and FlickType's unique algorithm will find the correct word from the pattern of your taps. 

FAST PUNCTUATION
Double space to add a period.

EASY EDITS
Use the Digital Crown to change words, punctuation, or emoji.

FAST, EASY & FUN.
FlickType keyboard users type up to three times faster compared to the standard keyboard, Scribble, or even dictation after edits. Emoji, text shortcuts, and deep customization options make typing fluid and fun, just as it should be — even on your Apple Watch!

NOTE: Currently only English is supported.

quotes.text:
> A separate version for the Apple Watch would remain, but then Apple pulled that one as well, telling Eleftheriou that keyboards aren’t allowed on the Apple Watch.

This is wrong, as far as I can tell. The watch app is still in the App Store.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flicktype-watch-keyboard/id1359485719

I just installed it and verified that it works, although the Watch keyboard itself is hidden behind a $10 in-app purchase.
quotes.story_title: Apple blocked the FlickType Watch keyboard then announced a clone of it
